grammar.summary: 本课学习表审美主观性的 as it were 与 no...more...than 结构。

points.title: as it were 表「可以说」
points.explanation: Beauty, as it were, is in the eye of the beholder. as it were = so to speak（可以说），虚拟插入语软化断言。

examples.en: Beauty is as it were a personal matter.

points.title: no...more...than 同级否定
points.explanation: No one is more pleased than I am. 否定比较表最高级：没有谁比我更……。

examples.en: Nothing is more subjective than taste.
examples.cn: 没有什么比品味更主观。
